description: List the user's active login sessions (signed-in devices and clients: mobile app, web, CLI, API) and connected agents (MCP integrations). Use this to answer 'what devices am I signed in on?' or before terminating a session. Each login session has an `id` (pass to terminate_session), a `type`, device/location info, and `lastActive`. Each connected agent has an `id` (pass to disconnect_connected_service) and `isThisConnection: true` marks the agent making this call.
name: list_active_sessions
